messages:
elaine: Hey team — quick heads up: I'm starting a small pass to refresh the hello-world quickstart. Goal: make auth flow clearer and fix the steps for first deploy (including Docker). Posting a draft in the PR shortly, pls 👀

matt: Thanks — quick Q: are we standardizing on SDK v4 snippets or keeping both v3/v4?

elaine: SDK v4 by default, but include a tiny v3 migration note. We got a few support tickets about missing `REDWOOD_API_KEY` examples in Docker.

sophia: I can add a minimal Dockerfile + .env.example. Suggest the auth snippet show both env var and header approaches. Small code block for the header usage helps: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

matt: Nice. Also call out okay defaults for timeouts and streaming vs non-streaming in the quickstart. A lot of users copy/paste and forget to set read timeouts.

elaine: Good point. I'll add a short troubleshooting section: socket timeouts, token errors, and common CORS issue when folks test from browser.

docs-bot: Reminder: per docs workflow, open PR against `docs/quickstart` branch and add the `quickstart-refresh` label. CI will run linkcheck.

elaine: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742 — folks please skim the auth section and Docker snippet for accuracy.

matt: Reviewed quick pass — left 2 tiny comments about wording and the curl example (missing content-type).

sophia: Added Dockerfile suggestion + .dockerignore. Also uploaded a tiny sample app under `/examples/hello-docker` and updated README with the `docker build` and `docker run` steps.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for docs-preview (PR 742) — preview at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-world (will update when complete).

elaine: lovely — once preview is live let's smoke test the auth header example and the env-based flow. If all good I'll merge and backport to `main` and add the v3 migration note. :rocket:

matt: Happy to do the smoke test after lunch.

sophia: I'll do a quick run-through on mac + linux containers and report any nits.

elaine: thanks team — aiming to ship this afternoon if no blockers. If anyone finds a broken link in the preview ping here and tag `@elaine`. :thumbsup:
